features: Eagle Eye Cloud Managed Video Recorder (CMVR): stores video locally and acts as a gateway to the Eagle Eye cloud
Video encrypted in transit and at rest
Supports ONVIF Profile S IP cameras
Supports IP cameras and NTSC/PAL analog cameras
License plate recognition (LPR) on up to 2 cameras
notes: Datasheet gives camera capacity as 16 analog (NTSC/PAL) or up to 35 IP cameras at 4 MP (typical); no combined total is stated.
Datasheet gives retention as 50 days for 35 cameras at 1 MP.
